_readme: RCF PUBLICATIONS - COMPLETE BOOKS AND EBOOKS ONLY
This file holds complete published titles: books, ebooks, published
study guides and teacher manuals published as books.
IT DOES NOT HOLD resource collections. Worksheet packs, lesson-plan
collections, model-paper collections and revision packs belong in
data/premium-products.json, which feeds the Premium Resources section.
The two are deliberately separate and must not be mixed.
A complete book, formally published          -> here
A downloadable collection of worksheets      -> premium-products.json
The list starts empty. No book titles, authors, prices or covers have
been invented. Until you add real titles the page shows a short note
instead of pretend books.
HOW TO ADD A BOOK
"id": "a-short-unique-name",
"code": "PUB-001",
"title": "The book title",
"author": "R. C. Fernando",
"audience": "Teachers",
"category": "Spoken English",
"description": "Two or three plain sentences.",
"format": "Ebook, PDF",
"price": "Contact us for the current price",
"badge": "",
"url": "PUBLICATIONS_WEBSITE_URL",
"buttonLabel": "View details",
"image": "",
"imageAlt": "",
"published": true
THE FIELDS
id           Short name, used only inside this file. Must be unique.
code         A product code such as PUB-001. It is printed on the card
and carried into the WhatsApp payment message, so you can
tell exactly which title a buyer has paid for.
title        The book title.
author       Usually R. C. Fernando.
audience     Who it is for, e.g. 'Teachers' or 'Grades 6 to 11'.
category     Educational books | Ebooks | Study guides | Teacher
manuals | Spoken English | Literature | Workplace English
description  What the book covers. Keep it factual.
format       Printed book, Ebook, PDF, and so on.
price        Leave as 'Contact us for the current price' until you are
ready to publish a figure. Nothing is invented here.
badge        Leave empty, or one of: New | Popular | Special offer
url          Use PUBLICATIONS_WEBSITE_URL and the build inserts the
bookshop address from _src/config.json. Until that config
value is a real https:// address, the link goes to the
'About RCF Publications' page marked coming soon.
image        Cover path, e.g. downloads/publications/cover-name.jpg
Covers keep their proportions and are never cropped.
imageAlt     A short description of the cover, for screen readers.
published    false hides a title without deleting it.

books.title: English Made Easy: Grade 6
books.author: R. C. Fernando
books.description: A practical English support book for Grade 6 learners following the Sri Lankan curriculum. It covers grammar, vocabulary, reading, writing, practice activities and revision, and is especially useful for learners who need additional guidance.
books.imageAlt: Front cover of English Made Easy: Grade 6 by R. C. Fernando

books.title: Grade 7 Support Book for Slow Learners
books.author: RCF Publications
books.description: A carefully structured Grade 7 English companion for learners who need simple explanations and extra practice. Its guided approach supports reading, vocabulary, language skills and confidence-building activities.
books.imageAlt: Front cover of the Grade 7 Support Book for Slow Learners, RCF Publications

books.title: Grade 8 English Support Book for Slow Learners
books.author: R. C. Fernando
books.description: A learner-friendly Grade 8 support book with simple explanations, clear examples and plenty of practice. It develops grammar, vocabulary, reading, listening and writing through approachable activities.
books.imageAlt: Front cover of the Grade 8 English Support Book for Slow Learners by R. C. Fernando

books.title: Grade 9 English Support Book for Slow Learners
books.author: R. C. Fernando
books.description: A simplified Grade 9 English companion offering guided lessons, supported activities and revision practice. It helps learners follow classroom work more confidently and build essential language skills step by step.
books.imageAlt: Front cover of the Grade 9 English Support Book for Slow Learners by R. C. Fernando
books.coverNote: A second cover design was supplied and is held as an unpublished alternative.

books.title: Grade 10 English Support Book for Slow Learners
books.author: R. C. Fernando
books.description: A practical companion based on the Grade 10 English Pupil's Book and the Sri Lankan school syllabus. Simplified instruction and guided revision help learners understand key classroom content and prepare more confidently.
books.imageAlt: Front cover of the Grade 10 English Support Book for Slow Learners by R. C. Fernando

books.title: Grade 11 English Support Book for Slow Learners
books.author: R. C. Fernando
books.description: A Grade 11 support book for pupils preparing for the Ordinary Level examination from a weak starting point.
books.coverNote: No cover was supplied for this title.

books.title: O/L English Grammar Practice Book
books.author: R. C. Fernando
books.description: A focused grammar practice book for G.C.E. Ordinary Level learners. It combines concise grammar points, targeted exercises and opportunities to check and improve answers, supporting both classroom learning and independent revision.
books.imageAlt: Front cover of the O/L English Grammar Practice Book by R. C. Fernando

books.title: The Complete O/L English Grammar Quick Reference Book
books.author: R. C. Fernando
books.description: A bilingual quick-reference guide that makes important O/L English grammar points easier to find and revise. Suitable for learners who benefit from concise explanations with Sinhala support.
books.imageAlt: Promotional graphic for The Complete O/L English Grammar Quick Reference Book by R. C. Fernando
books.coverNote: This is the promotional graphic, not a plain front cover. It is shown until a catalogue cover is chosen.

books.title: Let's Talk! Spoken English for the Primary
books.author: R. C. Fernando
books.description: Forty ready-to-run spoken English lessons for primary learners, designed for lively and practical classroom use. The lessons build confidence, everyday vocabulary, listening and natural oral communication through guided participation.
books.imageAlt: Front cover of Let's Talk! Spoken English for the Primary by R. C. Fernando

books.title: Twilight of a Crane: Full Study Guide with Model Answers
books.author: R. C. Fernando
books.description: A comprehensive secondary-level study guide to Junji Kinoshita's play Twilight of a Crane. It supports close study of the text through clear literary discussion, examination guidance and model answers.
books.imageAlt: Kindle cover of Twilight of a Crane: Full Study Guide with Model Answers by R. C. Fernando

books.title: AI for English Teachers
books.author: R. C. Fernando
books.description: A practical guide to using artificial intelligence to solve real classroom problems, prepare useful prompts and develop lessons teachers can use immediately. It emphasises classroom application rather than technical theory.
books.imageAlt: Kindle cover of AI for English Teachers by R. C. Fernando

books.title: English for the Workplace
books.author: RCF Publications
books.description: A practical manual of professional communication for learners and employees who need English at work. It develops language for collaboration, customer service, meetings and other everyday professional situations. Expanded Practical International Edition.
books.imageAlt: Kindle cover of English for the Workplace, Expanded Practical International Edition

books.title: Receptionist Practice Manual
books.author: R. C. Fernando
books.description: A hands-on training guide for front-desk and reception work. It supports learners and new employees with the communication, customer-care and workplace skills needed to manage common reception duties professionally.
books.imageAlt: Kindle cover of the Receptionist Practice Manual by R. C. Fernando

books.title: English for Caregivers
books.author: R. C. Fernando
books.description: English for caregiving work, covering the language of daily care, medical vocabulary, and speaking with families and employers.
books.coverNote: No cover was supplied for this title.
